records.field: 大部; PDF p. 922, printed p. 907; supplied scan attachment
records.text: The supplied scan shows the 大 headword, form chart, and account. The book describes the graph as a frontal standing person, and says oracle-bone and bronze forms have two hands extended and legs apart. It proposes ‘adult’ as the original sense and relates ‘big’ to it. I attempted to open the scan with a local image-reading command, but Python was unavailable; I therefore cannot claim a fresh visual inspection of its pixels in this invocation. The attached image is available in the input, but this record’s scan claims should be treated as supplied prior research until independently rechecked.
